scope: GDS prototype architecture only; no ADC, PVT, 20 ns conversion, or Stage-8 sign-off claim

conversion.latency: variable; result_valid_o only after all eight conversions and decode
conversion.note: 12 nominal bits and sample/hold do not establish 2 mV effective precision. An available 1.2 MS/s SAR IP cannot meet one conversion per 20 ns clock.

digital_decode.evaluated_two_dimensional_candidate: differential_cm_0p05_nearest_neighbour; worse than differential-only on current TT screen
digital_decode.evaluated_digital_activity_candidate: differential_unsigned_activity_nearest_neighbour; worse than differential-only on current TT screen

core_control.pwm: signed_WLP/WLN_row_pulses; 50 ps per magnitude-x2 unit is an unverified timing target
core_control.precharge: all eight bitlines to the verified initial condition before eval
core_control.substrate: VSUBS must be physically connected to the wrapper ground domain and LVS-checked
